more_info.overview: Polysorbate 65 is a mixture of ethoxylated sorbitol-derived esters of stearic acid; its preparation contains approximately 20 oxyethylene units per sorbitol-derived unit. Its emulsifying role is to help form or maintain mixtures of oil and water in the finished food. Made from partial esters of sorbitol and its anhydrides with stearic acid. The esters are additionally reacted with ethylene oxide. The specification does not identify a single biological source for the fatty acid. The specified preparation is a tan waxy solid at 25 degrees Celsius.
more_info.origin: Made from partial esters of sorbitol and its anhydrides with stearic acid. The esters are additionally reacted with ethylene oxide. The specification does not identify a single biological source for the fatty acid.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; flavoured drinks; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products; sweet baked goods.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
